# M0-f-02b: closing check of hardening round S2, leg 2 (lane `check/M0-f-02b-close-s2`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-11-12)

**Verdict: FAIL — one failing line (LINE 2, Q175 (b): one stated promise of the new deadline is unpinned).** The code
of all four rows is right on every probe this seat ran. LINE 1 (Q198), LINE 3 (Q175 (c)) and LINE 4 (Q186) are
confirmed. LINE 2's fix is right, but one of its promises is not pinned. `replayFixture`'s doc comment and the line's
required change both say the deadline is "no line for `hangMs` after the **last line**". This seat's mutant **C14**
moves the deadline only on a START line, never on a done or a crash line. C14 survives NEAR (69 / 69) and RELATED@1000
(43 / 43). A real-clock probe shows it is not equivalent: under C14, an honest child is wrongly stopped as a "hang
outside any seed". Under the brief's rule, a survivor on a stated promise that is not equivalent is a BLOCKER. The fix
is tests only (see "Failing line" below). The gates all exit 0. There is no other blocker.

## (3) New findings

**Failing line (blocker by the survivor rule).** LINE 2's promise "no line for `hangMs` after the last line" is not
pinned for a done or crash line that arrives *later* than its start.

* **Required change, tests only (no source change, NO-SHIFT).** Add one deterministic pin under the injected clock and
  the faked poll timer, in which a seed's done (and, in a second drive, a crash) is applied at a later clock value than
  its start. For example: start applied at T0, done at T0 + 1 000, then:
  * a poll at done + `hangMs` exactly declares nothing;
  * a poll at done + `hangMs` + 0.3 stops the child as `outside { after: <that seed>, ms: hangMs + 1 }`.
* **Mutant:** C14 must be red on that pin, under NEAR and RELATED@1000.

No other blocker. Every gate exits 0. Every interface and test id is present. There is no undeclared stub, no wrong
result on an honest input in the tree's code, no clean-room breach, and no path outside `plat/`. No note rows were
added: C16 is equivalent, and needs only its line in the table above.
